statement: Let V be the minimax final score difference for this game: V([]) = 0, and for a nonempty sequence xs of length n, V(xs) = max(xs[0] - V(xs[1..n-1]), xs[n-1] - V(xs[0..n-2])), where xs[1..n-1] is xs with its first element removed and xs[0..n-2] is xs with its last element removed. This V(xs) is Player 1's total score minus Player 2's total score when both play optimally from position xs with Player 1 to move. Whenever predict_the_winner(nums) returns a result r, r = true if and only if V(nums) >= 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 20 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^7.
